quotes.confounding: Patients who received TXA were matched by Injury Severity Score with patients who did not receive TXA... Multivariable logistic regression analysis of factors associated with risk of infection
quotes.selection: Data for this retrospective cohort analysis were collected through the Trauma Infectious Disease Outcomes Study (TIDOS), an ongoing observational cohort study
quotes.classification: Information on trauma history, injury patterns, TXA administration, and clinical characteristics... was obtained from the Department of Defense Trauma Registry.
quotes.deviations: TXA should be administered within 3 h of injury; however, information on the actual timing of administration of TXA is not available from the Department of Defense Trauma Registry.
quotes.missingData: From 1 June 2009 to 31 December 2013, 2593 patients were admitted... 335 patients received TXA and were matched with 626 patients who did not.
quotes.measurement: The TIDOS infectious disease module was used to gather data on infectious disease events and outcomes.
quotes.reporting: Outcomes were the rate of any infection occurring within 30 days after injury and time to development of infection associated with TXA. These were fully reported in the results.
quotes.overall: The study utilized a matched cohort and multivariable regression to address confounding, bringing the risk to moderate given the retrospective observational nature.
